top_signals.title: Gecko Robotics' USN Contract Expands to $300m
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Navy and General Services Administration (GSA) have increased the ceiling value of Gecko Robotics' maintenance and inspection contract to $300 million, more than quadrupling the original $71 million award just six months after its announcement.The expanded indefinite delivery…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
